# Commit guidelines

Write commit subjects and bodies in English. Include the following trailer
at the end of the commit message unless the user explicitly requests otherwise:

```text
Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
```

For example:

```text
Document dashboard session cookie security

Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
```
